Independent lab testing in 2025 covered 51 toothpastes and found detectable lead in about 90 percent of them, along with arsenic, mercury and cadmium in smaller fractions.

It was not just the cheap tubes. Davids, RiseWell, Boka, Bite, Dr. Bronner's and Tom's all appeared, alongside Colgate and Crest.

The metals are not added. They arrive with the minerals: calcium carbonate, hydroxyapatite and clays are mined, and they carry what the ground carried. Natural sourcing is the route in, not the protection against it.

Your supplement capsules are a microplastic source.

Across the categories tested so far, users take in roughly 5.89 plastic particles a day from supplements alone. The capsule is not neutral either: a 2024 study found encapsulation raised contamination in omega 3 oil by three to five times compared with the raw oil.

The bigger problem is how little has been checked. Contamination shows up nearly everywhere it has been measured, and most categories have never been tested at all. Absence of data is not absence of a problem.

Glyphosate is sprayed on conventional oats, wheat, lentils and chickpeas right before harvest, as a drying agent. Not only on the GMO crops engineered to survive it.

That timing is the whole issue. Spraying days before harvest puts glyphosate into the finished grain rather than into a plant with time left to process it, which is why pre harvest desiccation drives the highest residues in food.

Organic helps but is a second tier filter: it prohibits intentional use, allows trace residues, and requires no finished product testing. Look for Glyphosate Residue Free from The Detox Project or Non Glyphosate Certified from BioChecked.
